_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Workload Reporting System (WRS) Report
summary: The WRS Report documents contractor progress toward contract objectives and compiles monthly workload data used for resource management at Aerial Port locations.
use_relationship:
The Workload Reporting System (WRS) Report documents the status of the contractors' effort towards achieving contract objectives. The WRS is used to compile monthly work data for resource management purposes. Air Mobility Command (AMC) Form 82, "Monthly Station Traffic Handling Report [AMC-A4T(M) WRS]," is used as a manual reporting procedure for locations unable to access the WRS site. (AMC Form 82 can be obtained at: https://static.epublishing.af.mil/production/1/amc/form/amc82/amc82.pdf). The Report identifies a breakdown of specific workload activities at each Aerial Port location. The WRS Report is utilized to determine human resource and equipment allocations at air terminals.
This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The WRS Report shall be in Microsoft Excel format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The WRS Report shall contain the following:

children.title: For each Aerial Port Code (APC) location:
Number of WRS reports returned to the APC per month
Number of reports input into WRS by the contractor per month
Number of rejected WRS reports returned to the APC for corrections per month
System account information, to include the following:
Number of WRS accounts requested per month
Number of WRS accounts deleted per month
Number of WRS accounts reset per month
Number of inactive WRS accounts per month
Cumulative totals of activities, identified in 3.a. through 3.b. above, throughout the current fiscal year.
